verses.text: Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

segments.text: Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand,
Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.text: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

segments.text: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion:
Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

verses.text: Thy people offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.

segments.text: Thy people offer themselves willingly
In the day of thy power, in holy array:
Out of the womb of the morning
Thou hast the dew of thy youth.

verses.text: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.

segments.text: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent:
Thou art a priest for ever
After the order of Melchizedek.

verses.text: The Lord at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

segments.text: The Lord at thy right hand
Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.text: He will judge among the nations, He will fill the places with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.

segments.text: He will judge among the nations,
He will fill
the places
with dead bodies;
He will strike through the head in many countries.

verses.text: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.

segments.text: He will drink of the brook in the way:
Therefore will he lift up the head.
